facts.text: The Panhandle Promise Scholarship covers out-of-pocket tuition and fees for students who commit to teaching for two years in an Oklahoma Panhandle public school.

sources.title: Education - Oklahoma Panhandle State University
sources.quote: The Panhandle Promise Scholarship pays the expected out-of-pocket costs for tuition and fees a student would face after federal and state aid, and all other scholarships the student receives, are applied.
